ck: (29)petacintaratnan kata iti vyavaharikasatatatatnyanankikare sitasatanatavaranaya tatviketi pratiyokiti pratiyokina sananatikaranyasyavacetako yo tarno nisprakarakacEtanyaparoksotpatiparyantan svatikarane svapratiyokipratityavirotitvarupo tarnastatanavacinastatrahito ya patanistatyantapavastatpratiyokikanpukrivatitarnatikaranatvatityarta ayan pava parena hi sarvanityatvavatina katatvatinan patataviva svatikaranakatatavapyapavonkikriyata eva parantu katatvasya pate yotyantapava sa tatpratiyokikasananatikarana ata svatikarane pratiyokipratitin nirunati pate tu pratiyokisananatikarana ata eva kate katatvapavasatvepi katatvapratityavirota iyan pratiyokipratitirnisprakarakaprahnaparoksaparyantaneva utpane tu tasninayanapi pratiyokivirotyeva pavati evanca pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetako yo tarna svapratiyokipratityavirotitvarupastatrahito yotyantapavastatpratiyokikatatvatitarnatikaranatvan heturiti patanistetyevokte pata eva vyapicara parena svatyantapavasananatikaranatvan nityatvanityankikurvata patatvaterapi patanistatyantapavapratiyokitvankikarat ata pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacinetyuktan pate patatvatyantapavastu svatikaranapratityavirotitvarupoktatarnavacina eva katatvatyantapavastu na tata na ca kate patatvatipratitirapi pranarupa sanpavatiti tasyapi pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacinatvan nastyeva na ca pratiti pranakara vivaksiteti kate katatvapratiti pranatvanankikaratiti vacyan pratiterpracnanetaracnanapatyaya eva vivaksitatvat pratiyokyasananatikaranetyevokte pata eva vyapicara patatvatyantapavasya pata eva pratiyokyasananatikaranatvasya vaktun sakyatvat tata hi pratiyokyasananatikaranatvan hi pratiyokisananatikaranatvapava pratiyokisananatikaranatvan pratyapavonya eva evanca pratiyokisananatikaranasyapyapavasya pratiyokisananatikaranantarakatapratiyokisananatikaranatvarupatarnarahityan yucyata eva ata pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacinetyuktan evancapavantatarakatapratiyokisananatikaranatvasyapavepi pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakatvan nastiti na vyapicara tatra pratiyokipatan pratiyokitavacetakanavacinaparan tena
